# PiTTy v0.6.60

- **Subagents:** Detect live profile-driven workers using the parent Pi process identity even after compaction removes their original `agent_spawn` records. Current-agent status is refreshed every 3 seconds. The sidebar and inspector share the same current worker list. Previous-session children are never shown as live.
- **Background commands:** Retry failed `pi-bg-bash` status notifications, so a transient UI error does not permanently hide unchanged jobs. The read-only output viewer handles live/plain and finished/gzipped logs.
- **Diagnostics:** Separately report legacy runs, active profile-driven agents, and background tasks.

Local verification: 687+ tests, typecheck and runtime build. A live Torch session was confirmed discoverable without spawn-tool history, and saved `pi-bg-bash` logs were decoded. CI checks run on Linux, macOS and Windows.

Upgrade with `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.60`. It activates on the next launch; a running Pi process is not interrupted by staging.
